corrections_applied.issue: Agent wrote 'Dixon +12% followed its results'. This is a causal claim — a guess.
corrections_applied.context: Dixon PAT was DOWN 45% YoY. Claiming the price rose 'because of results' is editorializing.
corrections_applied.fix: Show price reaction (delta %, volume spike) next to results numbers without ever claiming causation.
corrections_applied.rule: NEVER write 'rose because', 'fell due to', or any causal language linking price moves to events.

corrections_applied.issue: TRENT has 0 concall transcripts on Screener.
corrections_applied.context: Promised-vs-Delivered requires multiple quarters of management commentary from earnings calls.
corrections_applied.fix: Keep TRENT in portfolio (for Briefing tab), remove from research universe. Research tickers must have >= 4 recent transcript links on Screener.

corrections_applied.issue: gemini-2.5-flash appeared in models.list() but was not callable (404).
corrections_applied.fix: Read model name from GEMINI_MODEL env var. Always make a verification generate call at pipeline startup before running extraction. Never trust models.list() alone.

corrections_applied.issue: Total tokens included 292 hidden reasoning tokens not logged separately.
corrections_applied.fix: Log prompt_tokens, candidates_tokens, thinking_tokens (= total - prompt - candidates) separately per call. Use thinking_budget=0 for bulk extraction to minimize cost.

corrections_applied.issue: QoQ calculation impossible from headline filing text (only shows YoY).
corrections_applied.fix: Parse the full 3-column SEBI-format results table from the PDF (current Q, preceding Q, year-ago Q). Also test NSE XBRL structured results as a cheaper/more accurate alternative to LLM extraction.
